prompts.name: DysonSwing
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production pixel-art golf swing sprite sheet for an existing game. The first input is a STYLE AND POSE SEQUENCE reference, not a background. Create ONE extremely wide horizontal strip with EXACTLY FIVE equal square cells in one row, transparent background, no labels, no grid lines. Each cell contains one full-body golfer and their golf club, with generous transparent space around them. Same character, size, viewpoint and feet baseline in all five cells. Low-resolution crisp pixel art matching the supplied 96px character style, limited colors, no antialiasing or soft painting. Golfer faces screen-right in three-quarter side view. Sequence left-to-right: (1) address at rest, (2) backswing, (3) club at top of backswing, (4) downswing/contact with club near ground to the right, (5) follow-through. No golf ball. Keep all character and club pixels inside each respective cell. Preferred canvas 960x192 or a 5:1 aspect ratio; exactly one row. Character: a sturdy athletic adult golfer in a dark teal polo, light stone trousers and a dark navy baseball cap; distinct from the blue-shirt reference. Consistent human proportions and readable silhouette.
